name: Leonid's Letter

angles.text: As an undead traveler, you see how Leonid's history with the Dark Lady keeps him from entering Undercity himself, reflecting tensions between independent undead and Sylvanas's loyalists.
As a Horde adventurer, you can enter Undercity's Trade Quarter amenities while carrying a message for an outsider.

faq.answer: Leonid is an experienced soldier with delicate ties to various factions. His complicated past with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner keeps him from entering Undercity, so he relies on wandering adventurers to carry messages to his acquaintances.
faq.q: Who is Leonid and why won't he enter Undercity?

faq.answer: Glix Xizzix is a goblin in Undercity's Trade Quarter. He appears to work near grooming services and keeps lost-and-found items left behind by absent-minded undead patrons.

Leonid has what he calls a somewhat colorful history with Sylvanas Windrunner, the Banshee Queen of the Forsaken. He uses neutral couriers for his business in Undercity to avoid provoking her or her guards.
faq.q: What is Leonid's history with the Dark Lady?

aliases: how do glix and leonid know each other
faq.answer: Glix remembers Leonid from their military struggles against the Scourge. He recalls the dread citadel Naxxramas raining destruction upon them.
faq.q: How do Leonid and Glix know each other?

faq.answer: Leonid told the courier that Glix would gladly pay a tip, though Glix had made no such promise. The goblin grudgingly offers odd trinkets from the salon's lost and found, left by forgetful Forsaken customers.
faq.q: Why does Glix reward you with lost-and-found items?

faq.answer: The letter goes to Undercity, the Forsaken capital, and into its Trade Quarter. Merchants, artisans, and goblins do business there under the watchful eyes of the Royal Apothecary Society and the city guards.

sections.body: Leonid asks you to carry a sealed letter to an acquaintance in Undercity. Past friction with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner keeps him from entering the Forsaken capital himself. So he trusts a neutral traveler to pass the city's guards without raising alarm.
sections.title: An Outsider's Errand

sections.body: Glix Xizzix does business in Undercity's Trade Quarter. The message recalls the time he and Leonid survived together beneath the Scourge citadel Naxxramas. Leonid promised compensation, to Glix's surprise and annoyance. So the goblin reluctantly pays with lost-and-found items left behind by careless undead customers.
sections.title: Old Comrades in the Trade Quarter

summary: In Undercity, a sealed message from Leonid's Letter awaits delivery to Glix Xizzix. Leonid keeps away because of his strained past with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, and entrusts the message to a neutral traveler bound for his old goblin acquaintance in the Trade Quarter.
